description: UK online beauty retailer selling makeup, skincare and haircare from hundreds of brands alongside its own By Beauty Bay range, known for colourful, trend-led products aimed at Gen Z and millennial beauty creators.

evidence.summary: Beauty Bay's own Awin merchant profile (fetched first-hand) publishes its commission structure: Beauty Bay Own Brand 10%, Standard 7%, Electricals 1%, Discounted 1%, Discount Code Partners 1%, on a 30-day cookie; a separate US programme also exists. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
The same Awin profile lists the brand's official social accounts: TikTok @beautybay, Instagram @beautybay and Facebook BEAUTYBAYcom.

name: Beauty Bay

reasons.compensation: Published rates on the network's own profile: 7% standard and 10% on own-brand products, with 1% on electricals/discounted lines — a solid mid-range retail rate.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through Awin only; no direct partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Established UK beauty retailer with a large own-brand range and a long-running network programme.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure beauty retail with a trend-led, creator-heavy customer base — squarely in the beauty UGC niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open programme on Awin that publishers can apply to join; no follower threshold is published.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand markets heavily through TikTok and Instagram creator content and lists its social channels on its programme profile, though no formal ambassador scheme is published.

description: THG-owned premium beauty retailer selling skincare, makeup and haircare from hundreds of brands, positioned around expert advice and dermatologist-loved lines, with regional programmes across the US, Canada, Europe and Australia.

evidence.summary: Lookfantastic's US & Canada programme on Awin (merchant profile 29067, fetched first-hand) confirms an open affiliate programme on a 30-day cookie, but the profile publishes no single commission percentage — rates vary by publisher type, so commission_rate is null.

Other regional Lookfantastic Awin profiles show differing structures (e.g. Content & Influencers 6% new / 3% existing customers on the International programme; 10%/5% on some European programmes), confirming there is no one global rate. No earnings-cap statement was found on any fetched profile, so the cap is unknown.

name: Lookfantastic

reasons.compensation: A real network programme exists but no single rate is published for the US & Canada programme and regional rates conflict, so this scores mid-low rather than on an assumed figure.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through Awin only; no direct partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: One of the largest premium beauty retailers in Europe, owned by THG, with programmes across many regions.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium skincare-led retail with heavy creator and influencer marketing — near-perfect fit for beauty UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open programme on Awin across multiple regional profiles; publishers apply through the network.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs influencer-led campaigns and content-publisher rate tiers on its programmes, though no standalone ambassador scheme is published.

description: Physician-dispensed clinical skincare brand founded in 2015 and now part of Galderma, built around TriHex Technology peptide formulas for pre- and post-procedure skin support and daily anti-ageing care.

evidence.summary: Alastin's Awin merchant profile (93113) lists a 5% commission with a 30-day cookie for its affiliate programme. The programme previously ran on ShareASale (merchant 103010) and product URLs carry both network parameters following the migration. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

Alastin's own affiliate page (alastin.com/pages/affiliate) invites website owners and creators to promote the brand for commission revenue, confirming the brand runs the programme itself alongside the network listing.

name: Alastin Skincare

reasons.compensation: A published 5% commission on Awin — real but at the low end for premium skincare price points.
reasons.contact_access: The brand's own affiliate page is a direct application route in addition to the network listing.
reasons.credibility: Galderma-owned, physician-dispensed brand founded in 2015 with national dermatology distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium clinical skincare with strong before/after and routine content potential for skincare creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Programme is public on Awin and on the brand's own page, though the clinical positioning skews to established publishers.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page recruits promoters for commission, but no structured creator or ambassador community is published.

description: MIT-born prestige haircare brand selling silicone-free shampoos, treatments and stylers built on patented molecules, including the Perfect Hair Day and No Frizz lines, through its own site and premium retailers.

evidence.summary: Living Proof's US Awin merchant profile (127005) lists a 15% commission with a 30-day cookie and names affiliate@livingproof.com as the programme contact. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The UK Awin profile for the same brand lists a lower 6.40% default rate, a regional programme difference; the 15% figure recorded here is the US programme's. A third-party directory (InfluencerRate) quotes 8-10%, which conflicts with both network profiles and was not used.

name: Living Proof

opportunity.title: Living Proof Affiliate Programme (via Awin, US)

reasons.compensation: 15% on the US Awin programme is a strong rate for prestige haircare, well above typical network beauty rates.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate contact email is published on the programme profile, plus application through Awin — near the top band.
reasons.credibility: Established prestige brand founded on MIT science, sold through Sephora, Ulta and salons internationally.
reasons.niche_fit: Prestige haircare with highly demonstrable results content — a core hair-creator niche brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open US programme on Awin that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand markets through creator hair content and runs an active affiliate channel, though no formal ambassador tiers are published.

description: Direct-to-consumer acne skincare brand selling kit-based treatments that combine clinical actives with botanical ingredients, marketed on a 60-day money-back guarantee through its own online store.

evidence.summary: Exposed Skin Care runs its own affiliate portal (affiliates.exposedskincare.com, powered by iDevAffiliate) where promoters can register and get tracking links — the programme itself is verified first-hand from the brand's own portal.

Published rates conflict across directories: Commission Academy quotes a 30% base rate, Lasso quotes up to 50%, and Olavivo quotes 15%, so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than guessing. No earnings-cap statement was found on the portal, so the cap is unknown.

name: Exposed Skin Care

opportunity.title: Exposed Skin Care Affiliate Program (own portal)

reasons.compensation: A real own-run programme exists and directories agree it pays double-digit percentages, but the figures conflict (15% / 30% / up to 50%), so no rate is recorded and the score stays mid-low.
reasons.contact_access: A self-serve affiliate portal is the application route; no partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Long-running DTC acne brand, but smaller and less independently covered than the retailers and L'Oréal/Galderma brands in this batch.
reasons.niche_fit: Single-focus acne skincare — a strong niche for problem/solution skincare content, narrower than a full-range brand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open self-serve registration on the brand's own affiliate portal.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand recruits promoters through its portal, but no public creator community or ambassador structure is published.

description: L'Oréal's luxury professional haircare brand selling salon-grade shampoos, masks and treatments (including the Elixir Ultime and Genesis lines) through its US site, salons and premium retailers.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory lists the Kérastase programme on CJ Affiliate at 7% commission per sale for the US (directory data dated March 11, 2024). No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown; the rate should be re-confirmed inside CJ before pitching, as the listing is not current-year.

name: Kérastase

reasons.compensation: A published 7% per sale on CJ — a fair luxury-hair rate, though the directory listing is dated 2024 and needs in-network confirmation.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through CJ only; no direct partnerships contact was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: L'Oréal's flagship luxury haircare brand with global salon distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Luxury haircare with strong routine and results content potential for hair creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed on a major network (CJ) that publishers can apply through, though luxury programmes typically review applicants.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand works with salon and creator content at scale, but no open ambassador programme is published.

description: Australian hair tools and accessories brand known for its pink waver, hot brush and interchangeable styling tools, sold direct-to-consumer internationally and built around creator-led social content.

evidence.summary: Mermade Hair's own Work With Us page describes its affiliate programme: powered by Refersion, affiliates earn a 15% commission when a customer shops with their unique code or link, customers receive 15% off, payments are automatic via PayPal, and milestone rewards are paid at $10K, $50K and $100K in sales. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

The programme's Refersion terms and conditions set the commission at 15% of the net sale price (excluding taxes, shipping, discounts and returns), a 30-day cookie, new customers only, and a $100 minimum payout threshold paid monthly via PayPal.
In the comments of Mermade Hair's own affiliate-recruitment Instagram post, the brand consistently directs interested creators to email community@mermadehair.com.

name: Mermade Hair

reasons.compensation: 15% commission on net sales is published in the programme's own terms, plus milestone rewards — a strong, transparent structure.
reasons.contact_access: A public programme page, an open Refersion registration link, and a community email the brand itself gives creators — top band.
reasons.credibility: Established Australian DTC brand with international shipping and a 590K-follower Instagram presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Highly visual hair styling tools made for TikTok and Reels demonstrations — a natural creator product.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Anyone can apply via the public registration page; approval is selective per the brand's page, but the route is open.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand actively recruits hairdressers, bloggers and creators on its own channels, offers featured-post opportunities, and structures the programme around content creators.

description: THG-owned US skincare retailer and authorised stockist of professional and dermatologist-recommended brands (SkinCeuticals, SkinMedica, Obagi and others), selling over 20,000 products across skincare, haircare and makeup.

evidence.summary: Dermstore's Awin programme terms describe the US affiliate programme: a dedicated affiliate team, product feeds, and commissions of up to 15% on select brands. The terms publish no single base rate and no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is unknown.

Third-party directories conflict on the base rate — Lasso quotes 5% per sale, LinkApprove 8%, Afftank 10% — while the network terms only commit to 'up to 15% on select brands', so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than picking one figure.

name: Dermstore

reasons.compensation: Network terms commit to up to 15% on select brands, but the base rate is unpublished and directories conflict (5-10%), so no rate is recorded and the score is mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through Awin and the brand's own affiliates page; no direct partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Twenty-year US skincare retailer owned by THG and authorised stockist for professional brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Skincare-first retail covering full routines across hundreds of clinical brands — excellent fit for routine and round-up content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open programme on Awin with a public affiliates page on the brand's own site.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The programme offers creator-friendly assets (feeds, dedicated team) and the brand markets through expert and creator content, though no ambassador tiers are published.

description: Clean beauty retailer founded in 2014, describing itself as the largest clean beauty store, selling skincare, makeup and haircare from brands that meet its Credo Clean Standard, online and in US stores.

evidence.summary: Credo Beauty's Awin merchant profile (61441, fetched) confirms an open affiliate programme — 'earn a commission' promoting its clean beauty catalogue — but publishes no commission percentage and no earnings-cap statement, so the rate is null and the cap is unknown.

Directories conflict sharply on Credo's rate (Lasso lists a 10% figure, Shopper 1.41%, Vendo 15%), so no rate is recorded. Separately, Credo's own Refer A Friend scheme pays store credit ($10 codes) — that consumer referral scheme is NOT the basis for inclusion; the brand qualifies through its Awin affiliate programme.

name: Credo Beauty

reasons.compensation: A verified network programme exists, but no rate is published on the network profile and directory figures conflict widely, so compensation scores low-mid.
reasons.contact_access: Applications run through Awin only; no direct partnerships email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: The leading US clean beauty retailer, founded 2014, with physical stores and a published clean standard.
reasons.niche_fit: Clean skincare and makeup retail — a core and growing creator niche with strong values-led content angles.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open programme on Awin that publishers can apply to join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Credo markets through clean-beauty creators and expert content, though no formal ambassador programme is published.

description: Hypoallergenic mass beauty brand founded in 1937, known for makeup and skincare designed for sensitive skin — including the Butter Bronzer line — sold through its own site and drugstores nationwide.

evidence.summary: Physicians Formula's own affiliate page states the brand runs its programme on the LinkShare Network (now Rakuten Advertising), pays a percentage of all referred sales monthly, tracks on a 7-day cookie, and reviews applications case by case. The page calls the commission 'competitive' but publishes no percentage, so commission_rate is null; no earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

name: Physicians Formula

opportunity.title: Physicians Formula Affiliate Program (via Rakuten Advertising / LinkShare)

reasons.compensation: A real network programme paying a percentage of sales exists, but the brand publishes no rate, so compensation scores low-mid.
reasons.contact_access: The brand's own affiliate page is a direct information and application route into the network programme.
reasons.credibility: Heritage US brand founded in 1937 with nationwide drugstore distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Mass makeup and sensitive-skin staples with viral hero products — good fit for drugstore-beauty creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Public programme page, but the brand states it is selective and reviews partners case by case.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand promotes creator opportunities through its newsletter and social channels, but no structured ambassador programme is published.
